documented_points: The category exporter URL is /export/categ/ID.TYPE and accepts a category ID.
Its page gives a from/to example but does not specify inclusive overlap semantics, recursive-category behavior, pagination, a response cap, or all-time sentinels.
detail=subcontributions includes contributions and uses the case-sensitive subContributions field for nested records.
detail=sessions exposes sessions and separates session-assigned contributions from the top-level list.
The documentation does not prescribe a public owner-page/material route for a nested subcontribution.
The Category model has a root and nested descendants, and generic category statistics describe subcategory inclusion.
This model/API documentation is not a statement that ESA's public /export/categ endpoint recursively enumerates every visible descendant, so it cannot by itself satisfy the source-universe gate.
